intent.subtype: signed operand zero-extended by an unsigned partner
intent.rationale: sample_s + offset_u is an unsigned expression, so the signed sample is zero-extended to 16 bits and negative samples become large positive values.

labels.note: signed sample_s added to unsigned offset_u makes the expression unsigned, so sample_s is zero-extended to 16 bits and negative samples give a wrong result.
sample_s + offset_u mixes signed and unsigned, so the expression is unsigned and the negative sample is zero-extended to 16 bits.
